verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions one. llms.txt, Markdown docs, an OpenAPI schema and a Postman collection are developer building blocks, and its in-product screening and transaction agents are a different feature; none of these is an MCP server an external agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
